item.title: Neurodiversity in the Earth and Environmental Sciences: Awareness to Action
item.description:
A panel discussion at the NWO NAC 2026 conference, addressing neurodiversity awareness and advocacy within the Earth and Environmental Sciences community — sharing personal experience alongside two other panelists and a moderator, in front of an audience of Masters students through professors.

“Pranoti is very open and engaging, which made for an amazing discussion about neurodiversity in academia. And I think she did a great job expressing a lot of the challenges neurodiverse people face in academia as well as in corporations. Just really nice to work with all around.”
